numeric_expression: gfa_m2 = if(lot_area_m2 < 408 m2; min(0.6 ratio × lot_area_m2; 204 m2); if(lot_area_m2 ≤ 697 m2; min(0.5 ratio × lot_area_m2; 279 m2); 0.4 ratio × lot_area_m2)) @(352)[SSP](A)

calculation_handling.description: Maximum floor space index expressed as a gross floor area cap by lot-area band: lesser of 0.6 x lot area or 204 m2 under 408 m2; lesser of 0.5 x lot area or 279 m2 from 408 to 697 m2; 0.4 x lot area above 697 m2.
States that no prevailing by-laws or sections apply; no effect on evaluation.

900.5.10(352).explanation: On the lands covered by Exception RT 352, the maximum floor space index depends on lot area: under 408 square metres, the lesser of 0.6 times the lot area or 204 square metres; 408 to 697 square metres, the lesser of 0.5 times the lot area or 279 square metres; over 697 square metres, 0.4 times the lot area. No prevailing by-laws apply.
